About Show - Mann Atisundar is the story of a girl named Radhika, who is born and brought up in Kanpur. Her family runs a sweet shop. Her father and mother are middle class simple people. Radhika is a very nice girl, the only drawback being in today’s world is that she is little on the heavier side. And that is the reason why her parents, especially her mother, are always concerned that she will not find the best groom for her because she keeps getting rejected by the boys as everyone wants a fair, tall and slim girl to marry. Eventually Radhika gets married to Divyam, unaware about the deal between her father and hero. We build on Radhika’s journey onwards, who comes in a family which is in complete contrast with her identity. She is being considered misfit in her looks, in status and education.
